name: Spaghetti Bolognese
ingredients: Spaghetti, ground beef, onion, garlic, tomato sauce, olive oil, salt, pepper
instructions: Cook spaghetti until al dente. In another pan, sauté onion and garlic in olive oil, add beef and cook until browned. Stir in tomato sauce, simmer 15 minutes, season, and mix with spaghetti.

name: Pancakes
ingredients: Flour, milk, eggs, sugar, baking powder, butter
instructions: Mix dry ingredients in one bowl and wet ingredients in another. Combine to form a batter. Cook on greased skillet until bubbles form, then flip.

name: Caesar Salad
ingredients: Romaine lettuce, croutons, Parmesan cheese, Caesar dressing
instructions: Wash and chop lettuce. Toss with croutons, Parmesan, and Caesar dressing. Serve chilled.

name: Chicken Curry
ingredients: Chicken, onion, garlic, ginger, curry powder, coconut milk, tomatoes, cilantro
instructions: Sauté onion, garlic, and ginger. Add chicken and brown. Stir in curry powder, tomatoes, and coconut milk. Simmer until chicken is cooked. Garnish with cilantro.

name: Chocolate Chip Cookies
ingredients: Flour, butter, sugar, brown sugar, eggs, vanilla, baking soda, salt, chocolate chips
instructions: Cream butter and sugars. Add eggs and vanilla. Mix in dry ingredients, then fold in chocolate chips. Scoop onto baking tray and bake at 350°F for 10–12 minutes.
